scenes.prompt: Police Day opening at the colorful clay car amusement park, thank-you cards hanging, festive bunting, police car Liangliang and sky-blue minibus on the road with a baby on a bench — match podcast cover composition exactly

Car amusement park decorated for Police Day June 15, many handmade thank-you cards on strings, police car Liangliang parked proudly near the entrance arch, red-blue lights on roof, cheerful daytime mood
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: match 亮亮警車 from cover page 1 exactly — dark navy-white police car, yellow star, plate 110, red-blue light bar. Same clay park style as cover.

scenes.prompt: Liangliang police car speaking calmly with steady expression, red-blue roof lights ready, then sudden worried call — sky-blue minibus Xiaolan rushing in from background, urgent but hopeful mood, same park
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Liangliang and blue minibus match portraits and scene 2. Liangliang calm leader pose. Minibus worried caring face. Each vehicle ONE face only.

scenes.prompt: Emergency at the park: sky-blue minibus with a pregnant human mother passenger looking pained inside, minibus pleading to Liangliang police car, crowd of faceless clay cars worried, ambulance not available, tense afternoon light
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: same Liangliang and blue minibus designs. Mother is human clay figure inside minibus window — NOT a car face. NO duplicate vehicle faces. Tension not comedy.

scenes.prompt: Red race car Xiaohong revving impatiently wanting to speed to hospital, Liangliang police car blocking firmly in front with calm serious expression, teaching stay calm when urgent, dynamic composition, same park road
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Liangliang from portrait; Xiaohong red race car number 2 from 小紅賽車 ref; blue minibus worried in background. Liangliang blocking Xiaohong — leadership moment.

scenes.prompt: Liangliang giving escort rules to blue minibus — follow behind, no overtaking, no sudden turns — minibus nodding seriously, police car authoritative but kind, road ready to depart
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: match scene 5 character designs. Liangliang gesturing instruction; minibus nodding. Same vehicles ONE face each.

scenes.prompt: Emergency convoy departing the amusement park road: Liangliang police car in front with red-blue roof lights brightly ON, sky-blue minibus directly behind showing its complete friendly windshield face (both eyes and smile fully visible), red race car far in background at the park gate waving — NO human passengers visible, NO faces blocked by windows, side view three-quarter convoy lineup, cheerful urgent departure mood
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: blue minibus MUST have COMPLETE face on windshield — two round eyes and smile, never cut off or replaced by a human. NO pregnant woman, NO human sitting in windshield. Liangliang front with lights ON. Xiaohong tiny at distant gate only. Match 藍色小巴士 and 亮亮警車 portrait designs exactly. Each vehicle exactly ONE face.

scenes.prompt: Busy clay city intersection, many faceless cars blocking the road, Liangliang police car leading with lights flashing using roof speaker to ask drivers to move aside, blue minibus following closely behind, urgent but orderly
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: convoy continuity from scene 7 — Liangliang front lights ON, minibus directly behind. Urban intersection NOT amusement park. Background cars faceless, no duplicate mascot faces.

scenes.prompt: Cars slowly pulling aside creating a clear lane, Liangliang police car carefully watching traffic lights and corners while leading minibus through the opened path, cooperative community moment, soft hopeful lighting
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: same convoy from scene 8, now with empty center lane. Liangliang cautious driving pose. Minibus still following. Lights still ON.

scenes.prompt: Hospital entrance with clay doctors and nurses ready with stretcher, Liangliang and blue minibus arriving safely, minibus exhaling relief thanking Liangliang, warm rescue success moment, hospital building soft pastel
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: convoy arrives — Liangliang and minibus stop at hospital drop-off. Human medical staff only, NO car faces on humans. Match vehicle designs from prior scenes.

scenes.prompt: Liangliang police car smiling modestly saying protecting everyone is my job, then cut to happy news — newborn baby clay figure crying loudly in hospital, everyone smiling with joy, golden warm light
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Liangliang proud gentle smile at hospital. Baby is human newborn NOT Bonbon. Can split feeling: left Liangliang, right hospital window with baby — same clay style.

newCharacters.desc: a cute claymation police car named Liangliang (亮亮), compact rounded dark navy-blue and white body, windshield forms friendly big round eyes and small curved smile, red-blue light bar on roof, white doors with bold yellow six-pointed police star, gray front bumper with white license plate reading 110, small black side mirrors, soft hand-sculpted clay texture, distinct from sky-blue minibus
